description: Cisco 7206 VXR routers accommodate a variety of network interface port adapters and an Input/Output (I/O) controller. A Cisco 7206 VXR router equipped with an NPE-G1 can support up to six high-speed port adapters and can also support higher-speed port adapter interfaces including Gigabit Ethernet and OC-12 ATM (Optical Carrier-12 Asynchronous Transfer Mode).
